summary: Read Chrome cookies for host www.crestron.com rather than the apex domain crestron.com.
reason: The forms-auth ticket .ASPXFORMSAUTH, plus ASP.NET_SessionId and CMSCsrfCookie, are scoped to the host www.crestron.com. Querying the apex domain returns only the .crestron.com-scoped cookies and misses the auth ticket entirely, so auth login --chrome failed with 'Cookie .ASPXFORMSAUTH not found' and firmware downloads stayed gated. spec.yaml carries the corrected cookie_domain so a regeneration inherits the fix; auth.go and doctor.go carry it for the already-generated tree.
validated_outcome: auth status reports Authenticated for domain www.crestron.com, and firmware release returns gated changelog text plus the direct .zip URL.
